cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Truth or Loyalty
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between protecting the relationship and answering a dangerous question honestly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My hand's out too. A brothers' promise. Will you tell Mum I broke her vase, or keep it between us?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking for the broken handle. She's blaming the cleaner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The handle, yes. Take it and clear the cleaner without naming me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked me directly whether you did it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then take my hand before you answer. Are we keeping this between brothers?

reason: Make the mistaken copied hand gesture become A actual loyalty test after B evidence request and direct-question constraint.
